name: Antivenom
description: Target may consume doses of the poison applied to their weapon to cleanse an equal number of DoT points or debuffs. Spending 1 Stash during casting applies the spell as if the target had consumed 3 doses.

name: Bog
description: Creates a 3x3 patch of sticky ground that applies effects of a known Common poison (chosen when Attuning this Arcana as a spell), creates rough terrain costing 2 Speed to leave. Creatures in area suffer poison while inside and for 1 round after leaving; stacking effects reapply when ending a turn inside. Spending 1 Stash allows any known Common or Uncommon poison to be applied.

name: Envenomate
description: Instills a mystical venom that bypasses poison immunity but inflicts half effect (rounded up) on immune creatures. When attuned as a spell, caster chooses DoT or Paralysis: spell inflicts 3 poison DoT or 6 Paralysis points depending on attunement.

name: Infest
description: Afflicts the target with 1 poison DoT that does not decay and cannot be burned off by normal means for the Duration (max Duration = Brief). Spending 1 Stash on caster's turn spreads the infestation to an adjacent creature (same spell, same remaining duration). Additional DoT points beyond 1 behave normally.

name: Poison Wave
description: For the duration, the target's melee weapon gains +1 Reach while it has a poison applied. Increasing the spell's Difficulty by 1 increases granted Reach by another +1.

name: Smog
description: Creates a 3x3 poisonous cloud carrying effects of a known Common poison (chosen when Attuning); obscures vision/hearing/tremorsense beyond adjacent. Creatures inside suffer poison while within and for 1 round after leaving. Spending 1 Stash allows any known Common or Uncommon poison to be applied.

name: Spine Strip
description: Forms a contiguous line of thorny spines up to the spell's range as an AoE (max Far). Creatures in the AoE risk 1 base soakable damage and have Speed -1 until end of next turn. Spines persist until start of caster's next turn and affect creatures that step on them. Spending Stash equal to a known poison cost applies that poison to the spines.

name: Thorns
description: Target is covered in brambles that lash out when hurt: when the target is hit, thorns attack adjacent enemies with a 1-success attack dealing 1 base soakable damage. Spending Stash equal to a known poison cost applies that poison to the thorns.
